title: Edge of Infinity — verify your account
preHeader: Verify the email address for your Edge of Infinity account
subject: Confirm your Edge of Infinity account registration
text:
An Edge of Infinity account registration was started with this email address. Your verification code is {{.Code}}.
Enter it on the verification page or use the button below. The code is single-use; the account service enforces its expiry.
If you did not start registration or change your email address, ignore this message. Reply to this message to contact support.
